description: Presidential secretariat - Boralugoda, Athurugiriya (Nallawala Kumbura) D/S/Division Kaduwela, Colombo District for Athurugiriya New Town Project
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition declaration under the Urban Development Projects (Special Provisions) Act. It specifically declares that described land parcels are required for the Athurugiriya new town development project. The content focuses entirely on land matters - identifying specific plots, their boundaries, and claimants - without involving government personnel changes or detailed portfolio assignments. This fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land acquisition and development projects.
